html:
Process [push,value] and [pop] operations on a FIFO queue implemented with two stacks. Return every popped value; popping an empty queue yields None.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      [
        "push",
        3
      ],
      [
        "push",
        8
      ],
      [
        "pop"
      ],
      [
        "push",
        2
      ],
      [
        "pop"
      ],
      [
        "pop"
      ],
      [
        "pop"
      ]
    ]
  ],
  "expected": [
    3,
    8,
    2,
    null
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    []
  ],
  "expected": []
}
Hint

Transfer only when the outgoing stack is empty.

Complexity: O(n) total time, O(n) space
